summary:
I have successfully found and resolved the data truncation bug. 

The issue was that `process_file` in `src/main.rs` was using `file.read(&mut buffer)` into a fixed 64KB buffer. The `read()` method only reads up to the buffer's capacity and silently leaves the rest of the file unprocessed.

I updated `src/main.rs` to initialize a `Vec<u8>` and use `file.read_to_end(&mut buffer)`, ensuring that the entire file is fully loaded and processed regardless of its size. The `test.sh` script has been run and confirmed the correct behavior without any data loss.
